card_summary: Drier climate (lower sea-surface humidity, evaporation and ocean supply) plus lower mountains via the peak override (~5182 m to 3600 m).

Make the climate drier and the mountains lower.

MODEL PROPOSAL
“Drier climate (lower sea-surface humidity, evaporation and ocean supply) plus lower mountains via the peak override (~5182 m to 3600 m).”
Peak override (optional)  (peak_m)   5182 m  ->  3600 m   -31%   (default 4000 m)
    “Lower the mountains: ~31% below current 5182 m (back toward the 4000 m default).”  (model's words)
Sea-surface humidity  (climate.ocean_hum)   1.00  ->  0.70   -30%
    “Drier sea air: -30% from 1.0.”  (model's words)
Evaporation  (climate.evap)   0.12  ->  0.09   -29%
    “Less moisture picked up over the sea: ~-29% from 0.12.”  (model's words)
Ocean supply  (climate.ocean)   1.00 ×  ->  0.70 ×   -30%
    “Cut the global rain budget by -30% for a drier world.”  (model's words)
4 settings refresh the climate with Recompute in the status bar.
Applying changes the settings, then refreshes the climate. The world itself is not replaced.
[Dismiss]
[Apply and regenerate]
